faq.q: Do you charge tenants a fee?
faq.a: No. For rentals handled directly, the landlord pays the agency fee.

faq.q: How soon can I view a property?
faq.a: Usually within the same week, subject to the owner's availability.

faq.q: Do you help with home loans?
faq.a: We can introduce you to a mortgage broker, but we do not give loan advice ourselves.
